_stagesComment: Stages a release can plausibly affect. Measuring a payment-flow change against homepage time compares pages the release never touched, so scope is declared for stages as well as storefronts. "all" means the whole journey.
_omitirComment: Releases kept on the record but left out of the report. They stay here rather than being deleted so the list still reflects what was published, and so removing one is a decision that can be seen and reversed.
